desc:
👋 Welcome to Would You Rather: Teamwork Outfit Tower!

Choose your team and help each other to the top!
Build your outfit on the way, by choosing a door! 👕
Each choice changes your outfit!  Will you glow up?, Or FLOP!✨

🏆 Climb higher each stage and earn coins + exclusive rewards!
😈 Use your coins to buy TROLL gear and mess with other players on the way up!

🎲 Every run is different, Every time you get random + unique choises!

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE rewards and updates!
